corrections.reason: 补全两台交换机的 VLAN 名称、每个接口和 LLDP 命令，纠正原解析省略绝大部分实际配置。

updates.explanation:
图中 Sw1：E0/1 数据 VLAN 77 + 语音 VLAN 177；E0/2 数据 VLAN 77；E0/3 数据 VLAN 88 + 语音 VLAN 188。Sw2：E0/1 数据 VLAN 88 + 语音 VLAN 188；E0/2 为仅语音 VLAN 177 的端口；E0/3 数据 VLAN 77。两台交换机分别创建并命名所有 VLAN，以下是对应完整示例：

```text
! Sw1
configure terminal
vlan 77
 name IT_User_VLAN
exit
vlan 88
 name HR_User_VLAN
exit
vlan 177
 name IT_Voice_VLAN
exit
vlan 188
 name HR_Voice_VLAN
exit
interface ethernet 0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 77
 switchport voice vlan 177
exit
interface ethernet 0/2
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 77
exit
interface ethernet 0/3
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 88
 switchport voice vlan 188
exit
lldp run
interface ethernet 0/0
 lldp transmit
 lldp receive
end
copy running-config startup-config

! Sw2
configure terminal
vlan 77
 name IT_User_VLAN
exit
vlan 88
 name HR_User_VLAN
exit
vlan 177
 name IT_Voice_VLAN
exit
vlan 188
 name HR_Voice_VLAN
exit
interface ethernet 0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 88
 switchport voice vlan 188
exit
interface ethernet 0/2
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 177
exit
interface ethernet 0/3
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 77
exit
lldp run
interface ethernet 0/0
 lldp transmit
 lldp receive
end
copy running-config startup-config
```

题干原称每口仅一个无标记 VLAN，同时表格给同一接口指定数据及语音 VLAN；采用语音 VLAN 标记的电话接入解释，需设备及电话支持，不能把两条 `switchport access vlan` 当成同时生效。Sw2 E0/2 以上例为仅语音终端的无标签接入口；如果实际电话要求带标签，应按电话与平台支持的部署调整。LLDP 提供邻居信息；native VLAN TLV 是否发送及支持取决于具体平台和 TLV 配置，不能仅凭 `lldp run` 保证。检查 `show vlan brief`、`show interfaces ... switchport` 和 `show lldp neighbors detail`。原题图是前题解答，正确拓扑已移至题干。
